new_code_audit_findings.detail: extract catches ValueError/OverflowError/TypeError per CSV row and silently increments invalid_rows, including duplicate-pair errors; complete_requested_window may still be true even with malformed or duplicate in-window logs. QA must reject completeness inference until invalid rows are separately reconciled by timestamp/block.
Source sort by event_at and hashed id; same-block event order is not provable without transaction_index/log_index. Do not infer intra-block causality or next-tick execution from sorted output.

complete_requested_window is computed solely from global earliest/latest timestamps, not canonical log continuity, factory-specific coverage or missing block ranges; this boolean is insufficient for admission.
